name: Another Dimension ~Tojikomerareta Gakuen~
original_name: Another Dimension ～閉じ込められた学園～
source:
Kengo is an ordinary high school student. One day, a new student, Mikage, transfers to his class. She is unfriendly to everyone so that she can't blend in this class. Triggered by an accident, Kengo makes friends with Mikage. A student in his class finds out students in other classes are disappearing one by one. Kengo and Mikage patrol around the school but they notice they can't get out of their school building. Students are trapped in the school building and they are getting....

translation:
健吾是一名普通的高中生。某天，一位名叫美影的转学生来到了他的班级。她对所有人都不友好，无法融入班级。在一次意外的触发下，健吾和美影成了朋友。班上一名学生发现其他班级的学生正在一个接一个地消失。健吾和美影在学校里巡逻，但他们发现自己无法离开教学楼。学生们被困在了教学楼里，他们正在……
